description.zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的地域。您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~2401682~~) 接口查询地域ID。
description.en: The region ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~2401682~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
The ID of the server certificate.

description.zh: 要上传的非阿里云签发的服务器证书的名称。长度限制为1~80个字符，允许包含中文、字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和星号（*）。
description.en: The name of the third-party server certificate that you want to upload. The name must be 1 to 80 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), underscores (\_), and asterisks (\*).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb set-server-certificate-name --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --server-certificate-id 123157xxxxxxx_166f8204689_1714763408_70990000000 --server-certificate-name mycert01 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
